plausibility.question: P1 gravity
plausibility.answer: NO: the spec frame (+Y up, +Z horizontal toward the user) puts the group head axis horizontal, so the portafilter mouth faces the user sideways; an espresso group head needs its axis vertical with the mouth down (grounds held in the basket, water down through the puck into a mug below). The carrier itself stands correctly on its foot, but it mounts the product the way it is not used (F1)

plausibility.question: P2 function chains
plausibility.answer: YES: the hub window (r >= 30.000) lies behind the housing's Oe26 hub opening and its r <= 20.93 openings; OD-G04 5.000 clear; the lower window R 25 is open for TUBE 7 and a hand; screws run from behind into the four inserts, coaxial 0.000

plausibility.question: P3 moving parts
plausibility.answer: YES: the carrier has no motion; nothing of it lies in front of z -24.94, where the portafilter turns; the housing seats along -Z with interference 0 at every step from 30 mm to the seat

plausibility.question: P4 grip, reach, insertion
plausibility.answer: YES: the four housing screws go in along +Z from behind through Oe6.5 counterbores, with 55 mm of free space to the z -85 thermoblock zone for a key; foot screws go in along -Y from above the foot

plausibility.question: P5 absurdity
plausibility.answer: NO: next to the De'Longhi Dedica the project copies, a group head mounted on its side with a horizontal portafilter is absurd; same cause as P1 (F1)

plausibility.question: P6 floating, embedded, mirrored, upside-down
plausibility.answer: YES: one solid, interference 0 with both neighbours, counterbores on the rear face away from the housing, gables pointing up in the print direction; the 90 deg turn of the whole layout is reported under P1

findings.at: spec 1.2 section 2 frame and A-02: +Y up, +Z (group head axis, toward the mouth) horizontal toward the user; also P5
findings.risk_basis: with the group head axis horizontal the portafilter basket stands on its side: dry grounds fall out on insertion and the brew leaves sideways, not into the mug under it; the carrier is built exactly to this frame, so the part fits the spec and not the machine
findings.fix_direction: the Usta settles the machine up direction first (A-02: -Z up, mouth down, as in the Dedica, would put the thermoblock above the housing along -Z); then re-concept the carrier for a vertical axis (e.g. the flange hung under a horizontal plate or bracket, windows for the hub tube above) and re-derive A-03 mug height from the portafilter spouts, not the housing side
